item.title: Bottom Bracket Shells
item.description: Notice that the title of this section is not “bottom brackets”. Right now, bottom brackets (and the cranks they are compatible with) come in two dominate styles: Square Taper and External. There a bunch of variations and that kind of annoys me, sure. But the industry as a whole seems to keep coming back to square taper bottom brackets with 3 piece cranks (which I love) and 2 piece “hollow-tech” cranks with external bottom brackets (which I don’t love but I also don’t outright hate).

item.title: Hydraulics
item.description: If it were up to me, everything on my bike would be adjustable with a 5mm allen wrench. I know that isn’t practical, but I would be willing to sacrifice a LOT of wait savings and sleekness to achieve that lofty goal. For now, I have settled on carrying a small tool kit with the essentials (4, 5, 6, 8mm wrenches, a small flathead, and a pair of quick link pliers). What I will never do as long as I live is carry any tools for hydraulics on my bike, nor will I have hydraulic brakes. The entire idea is preposterous to me.
